statement.excerpt: On the darker side, it really does arm attackers to a greater degree than Mythos’s predecessors.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that Mythos Preview has stronger offensive cybersecurity capabilities than earlier Claude models.
The surrounding discussion of an unreleased model makes this a capability comparison, not a claim that criminals already have widespread access.
I assess the current capability state described by the April 13, 2026 evaluation cited in the post.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable offensive cybersecurity evaluations show a meaningful improvement over earlier Claude models in completing attacks or producing exploits.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations show no meaningful improvement, or show that the apparent improvement disappears when testing conditions are made comparable.
